rawR q r: the argument pointer points to r : raw_byte within the C++ abstract machine.
mlock Definition rawR `{Σ : cpp_logic, σ : genv} (q : cQp.t) (r : raw_byte) : Rep :=
  tptsto_fuzzyR Tbyte q (Vraw r).

rawsR q rs: An array of raw bytes
Definition rawsR `{Σ : cpp_logic, σ : genv} (q : cQp.t) (rs : list raw_byte) : Rep :=
  arrayR Tbyte (rawR q) rs.

Axiom primR_to_rawsR : ∀ `{Σ : cpp_logic, σ : genv} ty q v,
  primR ty q v -|-
  Exists rs, [| raw_bytes_of_val σ ty v rs |] ** type_ptrR ty ** rawsR q rs.
(* ^^ TODO: rewrite this in terms of tptsto *)

Definition decodes {σ : genv} (endianness : endian) (sgn : signed) (l : list N) (z : Z) : Prop :=
  List.Forall (fun v => has_type_prop (Vn v) Tbyte) l /\
  _Z_from_bytes endianness sgn l = z.

decodes_int sgn l z: the bytes l encode z as an integer of signedness sgn in the byte order of the target.
Definition decodes_int {σ : genv} (sgn : signed) (l : list N) (z : Z) : Prop :=
  Reduce (decodes (genv_byte_order σ) sgn l z).
Notation decodes_uint := (decodes_int Unsigned).

(*

Axiom decode_int_anyR : ∀ `{Σ : cpp_logic, σ : genv} q sz sgn,
  anyR (Tnum sz sgn) q -|-
  anyR (Tarray Tuchar (int_rank.bytesN sz)) q ** type_ptrR (Tnum sz sgn).
(* ^^ should be proven *)

Lemma decode_uint_anyR : ∀ `{Σ : cpp_logic, σ : genv} q sz,
  anyR (Tnum sz Unsigned) q -|-
  anyR (Tarray Tuchar (int_rank.bytesN sz)) q ** type_ptrR (Tnum sz Unsigned).
Proof. intros. apply decode_int_anyR. Qed.

(* JH: TODO: Determine what new axioms we should add here. *)
Axiom raw_byte_of_uint_eq : ∀ {σ : genv} sz x rs,
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Unsigned) (Vint x) rs <->
  ∃ l, decodes_uint l x /\ raw_int_byte <$> l = rs /\ length l = N.to_nat (int_rank.bytesN sz).

C++20 basic.fundamental/3: for each value z of a signed integer type, the congruent value of the corresponding unsigned type modulo 2^N has the same value representation, so every bit pattern is a value.
Axiom raw_bytes_of_val_signed_unsigned : ∀ {σ : genv} sz z rs,
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Signed) (Vint z) rs <->
  int_rank.bound sz Signed z /\
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Unsigned) (Vint (to_unsigned_bits (int_rank.bitsN sz) z)) rs.

Lemma raw_byte_of_int_eq {σ : genv} sz sgn x rs :
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz sgn) (Vint x) rs <->
  ∃ l, decodes_int sgn l x /\ raw_int_byte <$> l = rs /\ length l = N.to_nat (int_rank.bytesN sz).
Proof.
  destruct sgn; last apply raw_byte_of_uint_eq.
  have Hbits : (8 * int_rank.bytesN sz)%N = int_rank.bitsN sz by destruct sz.
  rewrite raw_bytes_of_val_signed_unsigned raw_byte_of_uint_eq.
  split.
  - intros (Hbound & l & [Htyped Hdecode] & Hrs & Hlen).
    exists l. split; last by auto.
    split; first done.
    rewrite _Z_from_bytes_signed Hlen N2Nat.id Hbits Hdecode.
    apply to_signed_unsigned_bits_roundtrip;
      destruct sz; rewrite /bitsize.bound /bitsize.min_val /bitsize.max_val /bits_min_val /bits_max_val in Hbound; simpl in *; lia.
  - intros (l & [Htyped Hdecode] & Hrs & Hlen).
    have Hbound : int_rank.bound sz Signed x.
    { have HlenN : lengthN l = int_rank.bytesN sz by rewrite /lengthN Hlen N2Nat.id.
      have H := _Z_from_bytes_has_type_prop (genv_byte_order σ) sz Signed l HlenN.
      apply (proj2 (has_int_type sz Signed x)). by rewrite -Hdecode. }
    split; first done. exists l. split; last by auto.
    split; first done.
    rewrite _Z_from_bytes_signed Hlen N2Nat.id Hbits in Hdecode.
    rewrite -Hdecode trim_to_signed_bits_agree.
    symmetry. apply to_unsigned_bits_id.
    have H := _Z_from_bytes_Unsigned_bound (genv_byte_order σ) l.
    rewrite Hlen in H. destruct sz; simpl in *; lia.
Qed.

Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_int_zeros {σ : genv} sz sgn :
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz sgn) (Vint 0)
    (replicate (N.to_nat (int_rank.bytesN sz)) (raw_int_byte 0)).
Proof.
  rewrite raw_byte_of_int_eq. exists (replicate (N.to_nat (int_rank.bytesN sz)) 0%N).
  split; last (split; [by rewrite fmap_replicate | by rewrite length_replicate]).
  split; first (apply Forall_forall; intros n; rewrite elem_of_replicate; intros [-> _]; apply has_type_byte_bound; lia).
  rewrite -repeat_replicate; apply _Z_from_bytes_0s.
Qed.

Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_byte {σ : genv} (n : N) rs :
  has_type_prop (Vn n) Tbyte ->
  raw_bytes_of_val σ Tbyte (Vn n) rs <-> rs = [raw_int_byte n].
Proof.
  intros Hn%has_type_byte_bound. rewrite raw_byte_of_int_eq. split.
  - intros (l & [Htyped Hdecode] & <- & Hlen).
    destruct l as [|b l]; first discriminate.
    destruct l; last (simpl in Hlen; lia).
    inversion Htyped as [|? ? Hb _]; subst.
    apply has_type_byte_bound in Hb.
    rewrite _Z_from_bytes_singleton _get_byte_0_small_id Z.mod_small in Hdecode; last lia.
    have -> : b = n by lia. reflexivity.
  - intros ->. exists [n]. split; last done.
    split.
    + constructor; last constructor. by apply has_type_byte_bound.
    + by rewrite _Z_from_bytes_singleton _get_byte_0_small_id Z.mod_small; last lia.
Qed.

Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_float_intro {σ : genv} ft (f : float_type.car ft) :
  float_type.supported ft = true ->
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tfloat_ ft) (Vfloat ft f) (float_raw_bytes σ f).
Proof. intros Hft. apply raw_bytes_of_val_float; done. Qed.

Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_float_elim {σ : genv} ft (f : float_type.car ft) rs :
  float_type.supported ft = true ->
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tfloat_ ft) (Vfloat ft f) rs ->
  rs = float_raw_bytes σ f.
Proof. intros Hft. apply raw_bytes_of_val_float. exact Hft. Qed.

Definition float_bits_compatible (sz : int_rank.t) (ft : float_type.t) : Prop :=
  int_rank.bitsize sz = float_type.bitsize ft /\
  float_type.bit_width ft = bitsize.bitsZ (float_type.bitsize ft).

Lemma unsigned_bitsize_bound bs z :
  (0 <= z < 2 ^ bitsize.bitsZ bs)%Z ->
  bitsize.bound bs Unsigned z.
Proof.
  destruct bs; rewrite /bitsize.bound /bitsize.min_val /bitsize.max_val /bits_min_val /bits_max_val /=; lia.
Qed.

Lemma float_to_bits_has_type_unsigned {σ : genv} sz ft (f : float_type.car ft) :
  float_bits_compatible sz ft ->
  has_type_prop (Vint (float_value.to_bits f)) (Tnum sz Unsigned).
Proof.
  intros [Hbits Hwidth].
  rewrite -has_int_type.
  rewrite Hbits.
  apply unsigned_bitsize_bound.
  rewrite -Hwidth.
  apply float_value.to_bits_range.
Qed.

Reverse raw-byte reinterpretation is axiomatized at this abstraction level: raw_byte deliberately does not expose an injective byte-to-N view, so the existing integer raw-byte characterization is not enough to reconstruct the byte list needed by float_raw_bytes. The compatibility premise excludes the current Flongdouble model, whose Flocq bit encoding does not occupy all 16 object bytes.
Axiom raw_bytes_of_val_unsigned_bits_to_float : forall {σ : genv} sz ft z rs,
  float_bits_compatible sz ft ->
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Unsigned) (Vint z) rs ->
  raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tfloat_ ft) (Vfloat ft (float_value.of_bits ft z)) rs.

  #[global] Instance rawR_timeless : Timeless2 rawR.
  Proof. rewrite rawR.unlock. apply _. Qed.

  #[global] Instance rawR_cfractional : CFractional1 rawR.

  #[global] Instance rawR_cfrac_valid : CFracValid1 rawR.

  #[global] Instance rawR_wellyped q r :
    Observe (pureR (has_type (Vraw r) Tbyte)) (rawR q r).
  Proof.
    rewrite -has_type_or_undef_nonundef// rawR.unlock. apply _.
  Qed.
  #[global] Instance _at_rawR_wellyped (p : ptr) q r :
    Observe (has_type (Vraw r) Tbyte) (p |-> rawR q r).
  Proof. apply _at_observe_pureR, _. Qed.

  #[global] Instance rawR_type_ptrR q r : Observe (type_ptrR Tbyte) (rawR q r).
  Proof. rewrite rawR.unlock. apply _. Qed.

  #[global] Instance rawR_nonnull q r : Observe nonnullR (rawR q r).
  Proof. rewrite rawR.unlock. apply _. Qed.

  #[global] Instance rawR_agree : AgreeCF1 rawR.
  Proof.
    intros. rewrite rawR.unlock. iIntros "R1 R2".
    iDestruct (observe_2 [| val_related _ _ _ |] with "R1 R2") as %?.
    eauto using val_related_Vraw.
  Qed.

  Lemma rawR_tptsto_acc (p : ptr) q r :
    p |-> rawR q r |--
      Exists v', [| val_related Tbyte (Vraw r) v' |] ** tptsto Tbyte q p v' **
      (Forall p' q' v', [| val_related Tbyte (Vraw r) v' |] -* tptsto Tbyte q' p' v' -* p' |-> rawR q' r).
  Proof.
    rewrite rawR.unlock. by rewrite tptsto_fuzzyR_tptsto_acc.
  Qed.

  Lemma rawR_ptr_congP_transport p1 p2 q r :
    ptr_congP σ p1 p2 |-- p1 |-> rawR q r -* p2 |-> rawR q r.
  Proof.
    iIntros "#P R".
    iDestruct (rawR_tptsto_acc with "R") as "(%v' & V & R & HR)".
    iDestruct (tptsto_ptr_congP_transport with "P R") as "R".
    iApply ("HR" with "V R").
  Qed.

  Lemma rawR_offset_congP_transport (p : ptr) o1 o2 q r :
    offset_congP σ o1 o2 |--
    type_ptr Tbyte (p ,, o2) -*
    p ,, o1 |-> rawR q r -*
    p ,, o2 |-> rawR q r.
  Proof.
    iIntros "#O #T2 R".
    iDestruct (observe (type_ptr _ _) with "R") as "#T1".
    iApply (rawR_ptr_congP_transport with "[] R").
    by iApply offset_ptr_congP.
  Qed.

rawsR
NOTE: rawsR could have Param and Proper instances supporting genv_le, genv_eq.

  #[global] Instance rawsR_timeless q rs : Timeless (rawsR q rs).
  Proof. apply _. Qed.

  #[global] Instance rawsR_cfractional : CFractional1 rawsR.
  Proof. apply _. Qed.
  #[global] Instance rawsR_as_fractional : AsCFractional1 rawsR.
  Proof. solve_as_cfrac. Qed.

  Lemma rawsR_observe_frac_valid q rs :
    (0 < length rs) ->
    Observe [| cQp.frac q ≤ 1 |]%Qp (rawsR q rs).
  Proof.
    intros Hlen; rewrite /rawsR; induction rs;
      by [ simpl in Hlen; lia
         | rewrite arrayR_cons; apply _].
  Qed.

  Lemma rawsR_observe_agree q1 q2 rs1 rs2 :
    length rs1 = length rs2 ->
    Observe2 [| rs1 = rs2 |] (rawsR q1 rs1) (rawsR q2 rs2).
  Proof.
    generalize dependent rs2; induction rs1 as [| r1 ? ?]; intros * Hlen.
    - destruct rs2; [| simpl in Hlen; lia].
      rewrite /Observe2; iIntros "? ? !>"; by iPureIntro.
    - destruct rs2 as [| r2 ?]; [simpl in Hlen; lia |].
      rewrite !length_cons in Hlen; inversion Hlen.
      rewrite /rawsR !arrayR_cons;
        fold (rawsR q1 rs1);
        fold (rawsR q2 rs2).
      iIntros "(Htype_ptrR1 & HrawR1 & HrawsR1) (Htype_ptrR2 & HrawR2 & HrawsR2)".
      iDestruct (observe_2 [| r1 = r2 |] with "HrawR1 HrawR2") as %->.
      specialize (IHrs1 rs2 ltac:(auto)).
      iDestruct (observe_2 [| rs1 = rs2 |] with "HrawsR1 HrawsR2") as %->.
      iModIntro; by iPureIntro.
  Qed.

Integer views of raw bytes require an in-range byte value.
  Lemma raw_int_byte_primR' q r n :
    has_type_prop (Vn n) Tbyte ->
    raw_int_byte n = r ->
    rawR q r -|- primR Tbyte q (Vn n).
  Proof.
    intros Hn <-. rewrite primR_to_rawsR. split'.
    - iIntros "R". iExists [raw_int_byte n].
      rewrite /rawsR arrayR_singleton.
      iDestruct (observe (type_ptrR Tbyte) with "R") as "#T". iFrame "R T".
      iPureIntro. by apply raw_bytes_of_val_byte.
    - iIntros "(%rs & %Hraw & #T & R)".
      apply (raw_bytes_of_val_byte n rs Hn) in Hraw. subst rs.
      rewrite /rawsR arrayR_singleton. iDestruct "R" as "(_ & $)".
  Qed.
  Lemma raw_int_byte_primR q n :
    has_type_prop (Vn n) Tbyte ->
    rawR q (raw_int_byte n) -|- primR Tbyte q (Vn n).
  Proof. intros Hn. exact: raw_int_byte_primR'. Qed.

  Lemma rawsR_int_bytes q (l : list N) :
    List.Forall (fun n => has_type_prop (Vn n) Tbyte) l ->
    rawsR q (raw_int_byte <$> l) -|-
    arrayR Tbyte (fun n => primR Tbyte q (Vn n)) l.
  Proof.
    intros Hbytes. induction Hbytes as [|n l Hn Hl IH].
    - by rewrite /rawsR /= !arrayR_nil.
    - rewrite /rawsR /= !arrayR_cons raw_int_byte_primR//.
      rewrite /rawsR in IH. by rewrite IH.
  Qed.

  Lemma decode_uint_primR q sz (x : Z) :
    primR (Tnum sz Unsigned) q (Vint x) -|-
      Exists (rs : list raw_byte) (l : list N),
      [| decodes_uint l x |] **
      [| raw_int_byte <$> l = rs |] **
      [| length l = N.to_nat (int_rank.bytesN sz) |] **
      type_ptrR (Tnum sz Unsigned) **
      arrayR Tbyte (fun c => primR Tbyte q (Vint c)) (Z.of_N <$> l).
  Proof. apply decode_int_primR. Qed.

Module Endian.
  Section with_Σ.
    Context `{Σ : cpp_logic} {σ : genv}.

    Lemma decodes_uint_to_end :
      forall endianness sz l v,
        length l = N.to_nat (bitsize.bytesN sz) ->
        decodes endianness Unsigned l v ->
        decodes_uint l (to_end endianness sz v).
    Proof.
      move=> endianness sz l v Hsz [Hbyte Hdecode].
      rewrite /decodes in Hdecode.
      rewrite /decodes_int/to_end/to_little_end/to_big_end.
      split; first assumption.
      repeat case_match; eauto;
        rewrite z_to_bytes._Z_from_bytes_eq/z_to_bytes._Z_from_bytes_def;
        rewrite z_to_bytes._Z_from_bytes_eq/z_to_bytes._Z_from_bytes_def in Hdecode;
        [ | replace l with (rev (rev l)) by (apply rev_involutive)];
        erewrite z_to_bytes._Z_from_bytes_unsigned_le_bswap; eauto.
      by destruct sz.
      rewrite /bitsize.bytesNat length_rev.
      destruct sz; simpl in *; lia.
    Qed.

    Lemma decodes_Z_to_bytes_Unsigned:
      forall sz (n : nat) (endianness : endian) (z : Z),
        (int_rank.bytesNat sz = n)%N ->
        has_type_prop z (Tnum sz Unsigned) ->
        decodes endianness Unsigned (_Z_to_bytes n endianness Unsigned z) z.
    Proof.
      intros * Hsz Hty; subst.
      rewrite /decodes.
      split.
      2: {
        erewrite _Z_from_to_bytes_roundtrip; try reflexivity.
        move: Hty.
        rewrite -has_int_type.
        rewrite/bitsize.bound/bitsize.min_val/bitsize.max_val.
        destruct sz; rewrite/int_rank.bytesN; simpl in *; split; try lia.
      }
      exact: _Z_to_bytes_has_type_prop.
    Qed.

    Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_to_end_raw_int_byte (endianness : endian) sz (z : Z) :
      has_type_prop z (Tnum sz Unsigned) ->
      raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Unsigned) (to_end endianness (int_rank.bitsize sz) z)
        (map raw_int_byte (_Z_to_bytes (int_rank.bytesNat sz) endianness Unsigned z)).
    Proof.
      rewrite raw_byte_of_int_eq.
      exists (_Z_to_bytes (N.to_nat $ int_rank.bytesN sz) endianness Unsigned z).
      intuition.
      2: by rewrite _Z_to_bytes_length //.
      apply: decodes_uint_to_end.
      { rewrite _Z_to_bytes_length. by destruct sz. }
      apply: (decodes_Z_to_bytes_Unsigned sz); try reflexivity.
      by destruct sz.
    Qed.

    Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_to_big_end_raw_int_byte sz (z : Z) :
      has_type_prop z (Tnum sz Unsigned) ->
      raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Unsigned) (to_big_end (int_rank.bitsize sz) z)
        (map raw_int_byte (_Z_to_bytes (int_rank.bytesNat sz) Big Unsigned z)).
    Proof.
      intros H; apply (raw_bytes_of_val_to_end_raw_int_byte Big) in H.
      by rewrite /to_end/= in H.
    Qed.

    Lemma raw_bytes_of_val_to_little_end_raw_int_byte sz (z : Z) :
      has_type_prop z (Tnum sz Unsigned) ->
      raw_bytes_of_val σ (Tnum sz Unsigned) (to_little_end (int_rank.bitsize sz) z)
        (map raw_int_byte (_Z_to_bytes (int_rank.bytesNat sz) Little Unsigned z)).
    Proof.
      intros H; apply (raw_bytes_of_val_to_end_raw_int_byte Little) in H.
      rewrite /to_end/= in H.
      by destruct sz.
    Qed.
  End with_Σ.
End Endian.
